seo.description: Biossays 240 Plus is a Snibe biochemistry analyzer for routine testing: up to 240 tests/h with an optional ISE module. Supplied in Ukraine by LabWell.

keyFacts.label: tests per hour with the optional ISE module

T3_about.h2: What is Biossays 240 Plus and who is it for?
T3_about.text: Biossays 240 Plus is an automated Snibe biochemistry analyzer for routine testing. It processes up to 240 tests per hour, while the optional ISE module adds ISE testing on the same instrument.

items.text: The optional ISE module performs up to 200 tests per hour on the same instrument.
The analyzer operates with 80 reusable cuvettes.

testMenu.h2: Which tests can Biossays 240 Plus perform?
testMenu.title: Snibe biochemistry test menu
testMenu.text: The menu contains 13 test groups. Ask a LabWell manager about the availability of individual tests in Ukraine.

T10_faq.h2: Questions and answers about Biossays 240 Plus

items.q: What is the throughput of Biossays 240 Plus?
Can Biossays 240 Plus perform ISE testing?
items.a: Yes. The optional ISE module performs up to 200 tests per hour.

items.q: Who supplies Biossays 240 Plus in Ukraine?
items.a: LabWell is a Snibe partner and supplier in Ukraine.
